description: Controlled vocabulary defining air-entraining admixture types used in the material_batches tab of the Concrete Grand Challenge Experimental Database.

entries.definition: Air-entraining admixture based on wood resin or wood-resin derivatives.
Air-entraining admixture based on fatty acids or fatty-acid derivatives.
Air-entraining admixture based on sulfated hydrocarbons.
Air-entraining admixture based on proteinaceous compounds.
Air-entraining admixture based on natural resins.
Air-entraining admixture based on surfactants or surface-active agents.
Air-entraining admixture type that does not fall within the predefined categories.
Air-entraining admixture type not reported or not identifiable from the available documentation.
